description: Omaha, NE – Today, NEBFARMPAC, Nebraska Farmers Union’s PAC announced their endorsement of Denise Powell in the race to represent Nebraska’s Second Congressional District, noting her commitment to fighting for working Nebraskans as farmers are feeling the brunt of Republicans’ disastrous policies in Washington. Founded in 1913, Nebraska Farmers Union is dedicated to protecting and enhancing the quality of life and economic well-being of family farmers and ranchers, and their rural communities.

title: DENISE POWELL ENDORSED BY NEBRASKA FARMERS UNION - Denise Powell for Congress
